ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT] @DatetoProcessed [DATE] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
--FOR DEP FILTER
,CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP') AND (PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')  
)

-- FRO LNS FILTER
, CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('LNS') AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')
)
, CustomerAccountParticipation_SEC AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (

 -- LNS --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS  BCAP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DDA.SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

--FOR DEP FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP  BCAP
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId AND CAFP.PeriodEndDate IS NULL
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


UNION

-- SEC --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCAP.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM
CustomerAccountParticipation_SEC BCAP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCAP.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BCAP.LinkCode = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID  AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1


UNION


-- TRY --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCAP.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM
(SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, 'M' AS AccountHolderTypeId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' ) BCAP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCAP.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DAHT ON DDB.BankSK = DAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DAHT.SourceSystemCode AND BCAP.AccountHolderTypeId = DAHT.AccountHolderTypeID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchID,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount ) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE BCAP.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'  

UNION ALL

-- TRU --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,convert(varchar,BCA.CustomerId) AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM 
(SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,SourceSystemCode,AccountHolderTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM 
(SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BaseAccountId,SourceSystemCode, 'M' AS AccountHolderTypeId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'  ) BCA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BaseAccountId,InternalCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount) BCRBA ON convert(varchar,BCA.BaseAccountId) = convert(varchar,BCRBA.BaseAccountId)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,InternalCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedIdentifier ) BCRI ON convert(varchar,BCRBA.InternalCustomerId) = convert(varchar,BCRI.InternalCustomerId )
WHERE CustomerId IS NOT NULL ) BCA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID,CustomerSK FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDC ON convert(varchar,BCA.CustomerId) = convert(varchar,DDC.CustomerID)  --ok
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DAHT ON BCA.AccountHolderTypeId = DAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = DAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID 

UNION ALL

-- CCD --
SELECT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCA.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator             
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM
(SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD') BCA
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCA.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard BCAPC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAPC.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.PaymentCard BPC ON BCAPC.PaymentCardId = BPC.PaymentCardId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BPC.PaymentCardHolderTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeId AND DDAHT.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchId = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1

    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD] @DatetoProcessed [DATE] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC;
END;

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA;

    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
,
TEMP_CCD AS (
    SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (

-- CCD --
SELECT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCA.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator             
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM
TEMP_CCD BCA
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCA.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard BCAPC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAPC.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.PaymentCard BPC ON BCAPC.PaymentCardId = BPC.PaymentCardId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BPC.PaymentCardHolderTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeId AND DDAHT.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchId = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1

    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_SRC;
DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP] @DatetoProcessed [DATE] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_SRC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_SRC;
END;

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_DELTA') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_DELTA;
END;

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
--FOR DEP FILTER
,CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP') AND (PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')  
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (


--FOR DEP FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP  BCAP
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId AND CAFP.PeriodEndDate IS NULL
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_SRC FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP_SRC
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK

    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY';




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_SRC SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRY_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
